http-request.regex:
^(GET|POST|HEAD) /[a-zA-Z0-9/._?=&%-]* HTTP/1\.1
Host: [a-z0-9.-]+
User-Agent: Mozilla/5\.0 \([a-zA-Z0-9;: .()/_-]+\)
Accept: [a-zA-Z0-9/*,;= .+-]+
Accept-Language: [a-z,;=0-9. -]+

$
http-request.description: HTTP/1.1 GET, POST, or HEAD request with common browser headers; 200-700 bytes per message in format mode

http-response.regex:
^HTTP/1\.1 (200 OK|302 Found|304 Not Modified|404 Not Found)
Server: [a-zA-Z0-9/. ()_-]+
Content-Type: [a-zA-Z0-9/;=. +-]+
Content-Length: 0
ETag: "[a-zA-Z0-9]+"
Set-Cookie: [a-zA-Z0-9]+=[a-zA-Z0-9%_-]+; Path=/

$
http-response.description: HTTP/1.1 200/302/304/404 response, header block only (Content-Length: 0), so the CRLF CRLF that ends it cannot occur inside it; 200-700 bytes per message in format mode
